Out-migration rates dataset

Source: R/datasets.R
data_migration_rates.Rd

Data frame containing emigration (out-migration) rates by age, sex, and religion for 201 countries, used in the MRC projection models.

Rates were calculated based on two sources: Guy Abel's bilateral international migration flow estimates (Version 8) and the study "The Religious Composition of the World’s Migrants" by Pew Research Center.

  • Year. Year of beginning of a period for which the data is presented (numeric)

  • Sex. Name of sex [1=males, 2=females] (numeric)

  • Age_group. Names of age groups (character)

  • Country_code. Code of country of origin [standard ISO 3166-1] (numeric)

  • Christians. Emigration rates for Christians (numeric)

  • Muslims. Emigration rates for Muslims (numeric)

  • Unaffiliated. Emigration rates for Unaffiliated (numeric)

  • Buddhists. Emigration rates for Buddhists (numeric)

  • Hindus. Emigration rates for Hindus (numeric)

  • Jews. Emigration rates for Jews (numeric)

  • Other_Religions. Emigration rates for Other Religionists (numeric)

Format

Data frame with 8040 rows and 11 variables

References

Pew-CASPAR Measuring Religious Change Project; Kramer, S., & Tong, Y. (2024). The religious composition of the world’s migrants. Pew Research Center; Abel, G. J. (2025). Bilateral international migration flow estimates for 200 countries (Version 8). Retrieved from https://guyabel.com/publication/bilateral-migration-flow-sex/
